verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Clerk capability for asynchronous, out-of-band human approval (CIBA-style) of a specific agent transaction. The nearby features are adjacent, not this capability: the device authorization grant approves initial access for browserless devices, reverification requires recent user authentication before sensitive actions, and eve tool-call gating checks permissions and scopes without asking a human to confirm.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can require asynchronous human approval (e.g. CIBA-style confirmation) before an autonomous agent completes a sensitive transaction
